note: Growth failure (growth delay) is the condition treated; the IGF-1 deficiency is the qualifying cause.

note: DCIS is listed as a named indication heading and tamoxifen is given as adjuvant management of DCIS after surgery/radiation to prevent progression to invasive cancer.

quote: indicated to reduce the risk of stroke in patients with hypertension and left ventricular hypertrophy
note: LVH is only the patient population; the thing prevented is stroke, not the hypertrophy.

quote: SILIQ (brodalumab) is indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe plaque psoriasis in adult patients
note: Chronic small plaque psoriasis is a morphological subtype of plaque psoriasis, which is the indicated condition (FDA and EMA).

quote: Septicemia, empyema, pneumonia, pericarditis, endocarditis, meningitis Streptococcus pyogenes
note: Empyema is a named item in the list of indicated conditions.

quote: Treatment of multiple myeloma.
note: Multiple myeloma is an exact synonym of plasma cell myeloma, named in the EMA indication.

quote: symptomatic treatment of endometriosis in women with a history of previous medical or surgical treatment for their endometriosis
note: EMA names symptomatic treatment of endometriosis and FDA names management of endometriosis-associated pain; relugolix (the GnRH antagonist) is the active component for this indication.

quote: Also for the treatment of the condition in which iron deficiency and vitamin C deficiency occur together
note: Vitamin C deficiency (scurvy) appears only on multi-ingredient iron/vitamin C/folate labels and is attributable to the vitamin C component, not folic acid.

note: Osteoarthritis is indicated only on the naproxen/esomeprazole combination label and is explicitly attributed to the naproxen component; esomeprazole's role is gastric-ulcer risk reduction.

quote: temporarily relieves nasal decongestion due to: common cold hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies (allergic rhinitis)
note: The text treats the symptom (nasal congestion) due to allergic rhinitis, not the rhinitis itself, matching the rubric's common-cold example.

quote: Bartonellosis due to Bartonella bacilliformis .
note: Bartonellosis is named directly as an indication.

quote: Chenodiol is indicated for patients with radiolucent stones in well-opacifying gallbladders
note: Dissolution of radiolucent gallstones is treatment of cholelithiasis.

quote: Upper respiratory tract infections of mild to moderate degree caused by Streptococcus pyogenes
note: Upper respiratory tract infection is indicated; recurrent URTI is a narrower form of it, and long-term prophylaxis of recurrent streptococcal pharyngitis is also named.

quote: indicated for the reduction of elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
note: Reducing elevated IOP in ocular hypertension is treatment of ocular hypertension itself, not merely a setting.

quote: growth failure due to inadequate secretion of endogenous growth hormone (GH). Replacement of endogenous growth hormone in adults with growth hormone deficiency (GHD).
note: Inadequate endogenous GH secretion / GH deficiency is the condition treated by replacement, matching reduced circulating growth hormone.

quote: LIVDELZI is indicated for the treatment of primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) in combination with ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA)
note: PBC is named directly as the treated disease.

quote: Treatment of secondary hyperparathyroidism (HPT) in adult patients with end-stage renal disease (ESRD) on maintenance dialysis therapy.
note: ESRD is only the patient population; the treated condition is secondary hyperparathyroidism.

quote: Tinidazole is indicated for the treatment of trichomoniasis caused by Trichomonas vaginalis.
note: Trichomoniasis is named directly as an indication.

quote: Acitretin Capsules, USP are indicated for the treatment of severe psoriasis in adults.
note: Severe psoriasis is a narrower form of psoriasis, so the edge is TARGET.

quote: refractory anemia with excess blasts (RAEB), refractory anemia with excess blasts in transformation (RAEB-T), and chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (CMMoL).
note: RAEB-T is explicitly listed among the indicated MDS subtypes.

quote: SOTYKTU is indicated for the treatment of active psoriatic arthritis in adults.
note: Psoriatic arthritis is named directly as an indication.

quote: Useful in the management of pruritus due to allergic conditions such as chronic urticaria and atopic and contact dermatoses
note: Chronic urticaria is named as a condition whose pruritus is managed and also as an allergic condition for adjunctive therapy, so management of the disease counts.

quote: for the temporary relief of these symptoms associated with menstrual periods: cramps bloating water-weight gain headache
note: Headache appears only on multi-ingredient menstrual-relief labels containing acetaminophen (per the warnings), to which the analgesic claim belongs; single-ingredient mepyramine labels list only allergy symptoms.
Fever or any febrile disorder is not mentioned anywhere in the supplied text; indications are vitamin supplementation and folate/iron deficiency.

note: Edotreotide is a diagnostic imaging agent only ("for diagnostic use only"); GEP-NET is the population imaged, not a condition treated.

quote: It has also been found useful in the treatment of acute non-lymphocytic leukemia and the blast phase of chronic myelocytic leukemia.
note: Blast phase CML is a phase of chronic myeloid leukemia, a near parent that still describes what is indicated.

quote: Treatment of essential hypertension.
note: EMA names essential hypertension directly, and single-ingredient valsartan is indicated for hypertension.

quote: RITUXAN, in combination with glucocorticoids, is indicated for the treatment of adult and pediatric patients 2 years of age and older with Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis (GPA)
note: GPA is named directly as an indication in both FDA and EMA text.

quote: indicated for the treatment of OAB in adult patients with symptoms of urge urinary incontinence, urgency, and urinary frequency
note: Urge urinary incontinence is explicitly named as a symptom of OAB that the drug treats, so it is a managed manifestation rather than a mere setting.

quote: indicated to decrease the incidence of infection, as manifested by febrile neutropenia, in adult patients with non-myeloid malignancies receiving myelosuppressive anti-cancer drugs
note: Prevention of febrile neutropenia is the stated purpose of the drug.
